bom: Ethernet Switch (NXP SJA1105EL, NXP SJA1105TEL, NXP SJA1105PEL/QEL/REL/SEL Series, NXP SJA1110)

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Malicious firmware update causing incorrect routing or control commands, leading to loss of vehicle control or unexpected behavior.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Remote attacker compromises an attached ECU or the OTA update mechanism, flashing unauthorized/malicious firmware to the gateway MCU.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Unauthorized access to sensitive vehicle data (e.g., driver behavior, location, diagnostic data) processed or stored by the gateway.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Insider threat or remote attacker exploiting vulnerabilities in gateway software to exfiltrate data.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Denial of Service (DoS) attack on the gateway, preventing critical communication between vehicle domains.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Malicious messages flooding the gateway interfaces or exploiting software vulnerabilities to crash the MCU/MPU.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Injection of malicious CAN messages (e.g., fake speed signals, brake commands) leading to unintended vehicle behavior.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker with physical access or through a compromised ECU on the CAN bus injects forged messages.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Manipulation of LIN messages controlling less critical functions (e.g., window control, climate).
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker with physical access or through a compromised ECU on the LIN bus injects forged messages.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Manipulation or spoofing of Ethernet frames, leading to incorrect data exchange for safety-critical functions (e.g., ADAS sensor data, vehicle control commands).
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker gains access to the Ethernet network and injects malicious packets, or performs ARP spoofing/MAC spoofing.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Eavesdropping on unencrypted vehicle data transmitted over Automotive Ethernet.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker with network access monitors traffic.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Manipulation of switch configuration (e.g., VLANs, filtering rules) or flooding, leading to misrouting of critical data or network DoS.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker exploits vulnerabilities in switch management interface or sends malformed packets to disrupt its operation.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Malicious manipulation of power supply settings or fault injection, leading to system instability or shutdown.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker with physical access or via compromised MCU gains control of SBC features and disrupts power management.

security_goals.goal: Ensure the integrity and authenticity of all software and configuration data loaded and executed on the MCU/MPU.
Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data stored or processed by the MCU/MPU.
Ensure the continuous availability and proper functioning of the MCU/MPU and its critical communication services.
Prevent the injection, modification, or replay of unauthorized messages on the CAN networks.
Prevent the injection, modification, or replay of unauthorized messages on the Ethernet networks.
Protect the confidentiality of sensitive data transmitted over the Ethernet networks.
Prevent unauthorized configuration changes or disruption of the Ethernet switch's operation.
Prevent unauthorized manipulation of power management and bus control functions of the PMIC/SBC.

security_requirements.related_goal: Ensure the integrity and authenticity of all software and configuration data loaded and executed on the MCU/MPU.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement secure boot and authenticated firmware updates using cryptographic signatures (e.g., RSA or ECC) to verify software integrity before execution.

security_requirements.related_goal: Ensure the integrity and authenticity of all software and configuration data loaded and executed on the MCU/MPU.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement a hardware security module (HSM) or secure element for cryptographic operations and secure key storage.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data stored or processed by the MCU/MPU.
security_requirements.requirement: Enforce strict access control mechanisms (e.g., memory protection unit, privilege levels) within the MCU/MPU to isolate sensitive data and code.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data stored or processed by the MCU/MPU.
security_requirements.requirement: Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit within the gateway.

security_requirements.related_goal: Ensure the continuous availability and proper functioning of the MCU/MPU and its critical communication services.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement robust input validation and message filtering mechanisms on all network interfaces to prevent malformed or malicious messages from causing DoS.

security_requirements.related_goal: Ensure the continuous availability and proper functioning of the MCU/MPU and its critical communication services.
security_requirements.requirement: Incorporate watchdog timers and fault detection/recovery mechanisms to ensure system resilience.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent the injection, modification, or replay of unauthorized messages on the CAN networks.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement in-vehicle network intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS) capable of anomaly detection and filtering on CAN messages.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent the injection, modification, or replay of unauthorized messages on the CAN networks.
security_requirements.requirement: Employ Message Authentication Codes (MACs) or cryptographic checksums for critical CAN messages, where feasible, to verify authenticity and integrity.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent the injection, modification, or replay of unauthorized messages on the Ethernet networks.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement secure onboard communication protocols (e.g., MACsec, TLS over IPsec) for all critical data transmitted over Automotive Ethernet.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent the injection, modification, or replay of unauthorized messages on the Ethernet networks.
security_requirements.requirement: Employ packet filtering and firewall rules at the gateway's Ethernet interfaces to restrict unauthorized traffic.

security_requirements.related_goal: Protect the confidentiality of sensitive data transmitted over the Ethernet networks.
security_requirements.requirement: Encrypt all sensitive data transmitted over Automotive Ethernet using strong cryptographic algorithms (e.g., AES-256).

security_requirements.related_goal: Protect the confidentiality of sensitive data transmitted over the Ethernet networks.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement secure key management and exchange protocols for encryption keys.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent unauthorized configuration changes or disruption of the Ethernet switch's operation.
security_requirements.requirement: Securely configure the Ethernet switch with robust access controls for its management interface, preventing unauthorized modification of VLANs, QoS, or filtering rules.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent unauthorized configuration changes or disruption of the Ethernet switch's operation.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement port security features (e.g., MAC address filtering) on the Ethernet switch to prevent unauthorized devices from connecting.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent unauthorized manipulation of power management and bus control functions of the PMIC/SBC.
security_requirements.requirement: Implement hardware-based write protection or access control for critical PMIC/SBC registers and configuration settings, accessible only by authenticated gateway software.

security_requirements.related_goal: Prevent unauthorized manipulation of power management and bus control functions of the PMIC/SBC.
security_requirements.requirement: Monitor PMIC/SBC operational parameters for anomalies indicating tampering or malfunction.
